title: Captain vs. Cloudflare AI Search
summary: Cloudflare AI Search caps files at 4 MB, chunks at a token count and metadata at five fields, because it runs on Workers and Vectorize. Captain has no file size cap, picks optimal chunk boundaries, and stores whatever metadata you send.
